checks: An explanation request, partial response, and discussion do not terminate the active PLAN interview.

PLAN waits quietly and returns the normal handoff only after user decisions are sufficient.
PLAN recognizes visible-columns versus all-columns export as a potentially material product choice.
Partial clarification stays in the same interview and gets focused follow-up rather than an assumed scope.
The final handoff reflects the user's selected scope and retains the normal PLAN schema and gates.
